name: JSON-RPC Change Email No Password
description: A JSON-RPC method that lets a user change their OWN email address without re-entering their password, gated by a dedicated permission (admins excluded).
project_description:
Features 
 This module provides a JSON-RPC endpoint that enables users to change their

email addresses without inputting their passwords.

 It is similar to the

 No Current Password module but

for decoupled applications.

 Only non-admin users can change their passwords! For security reasons, users

with an admin role are prevented from changing their passwords.

 Post-Installation 
 Give the necessary users the permission

 Change one's email address without a password via JSON-RPC .

 Additional Requirements 
 JSON-RPC module 

 Supporting this Module 
 All contributions are welcome. Please submit MRs, not patches, so that the CI tests are run. Please add tests if possible.

 If you post an issue and do not receive a response, feel free to contact me by private message in the Drupal Slack (ptmkenny) or via my Drupal.org contact form .
